title: Do not audit factual leakage using question-text similarity alone.
body: 21/60 T2 factual questions are training facts rewritten or reversed. Answer-key matching catches them (F-284).

title: Do not lock thresholds without power simulation for each condition and the composite.
body: Gerbang-S1 v1.1 passes with probability ≤ 0.22 even when S is much better: the factual condition across independent runs with 8 questions is a lottery, and one condition penalizes its own training goal (F-284).

title: Do not ask the teacher model to write the scorer regex.
body: It writes ^…$-anchored patterns that never match within answer sentences. Ask for a list of key phrases and build the patterns in code (F-284).

title: Small max_tokens for deepseek-flash = empty output.
body: The model thinks by default, max_tokens includes reasoning tokens, and temperature is not supported in thinking mode. Specify mode + budget ≥ 16K and require finish_reason = stop (F-284, 27 Sep).

title: An agent with isolation: "remote" in a desktop session runs LOCALLY
body: (±382 thousand tokens of local quota, 26 Sep). That is not a cloud path.

title: Question factory without a pattern file.
body: flywheel/pabrik-soal.mjs is ready, but flywheel/dataset/pola-jebakan.json was never created (found 27 Sep). Do not rely on it before the patterns exist.

title: A workflow-data experiment (H-ALUR) on a workflow not performed daily = stopped on day 1.
body: Ensure the flow exists BEFORE the clock starts.

title: Claude outputs/labels never become training data
body: (Anthropic Usage Policy, F-282). Gemini, Z.ai, Alibaba, and OpenAI APIs = display-only. Teacher status follows the access path, not the model name.

title: A subagent in a working session is NOT a blind judge.
body: It inherits CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/memory. Use context-free claude -p (F-281).

title: LLM judging through the Max plan allowance is unsustainable.
body: D1 labeling exhausted the 5-hour session limit after 6/64 batches. Budget judges through API credits, not the Max allowance.

title: A heavy agent framework (Hermes) + 4B on CPU = timeout/RAM
body: , because of 16–71 thousand tokens per turn (doc 30). Hermes itself requires context ≥ 64K (F-282).

title: An LLM probe as a gate: effective but slow.
body: Fabrication drops 18 pp (GERBANG-ON), but takes 3–17 s per question, so E1 GAGAL on latency. Its replacement is being tested: Gerbang-S1.

title: Retrieval signal threshold for a gate = does not separate populations.
body: Traps actually have stronger signals (#vonisSinyalSumber_3Sep_HIPOTESIS_DITOLAK). The "context-aware" probe prompt (A9): its recall gain is an artifact (#vonisA9_3Sep).

title: An NLI checker after the answer, without fine-tuning = not viable.
A gate trained only on QUESTION features + small data = blocks factual questions.
body: A7 (3 Sep; k-NN on bge-m3, 97 questions) refuses 7/8 factual questions (PRA-DAFTAR-GERBANG-JEBAKAN.json#vonisA7_3Sep).

title: A newer/larger base ≠ more honest.
body: Qwen3.5-4B/9B did not beat Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on petak-jujur2 (SB1 TETAP_Q3, F-283). Size adds coverage, not knowledge boundaries.

title: Training an own 4B model for honesty = makes it worse.
body: Fabrication rate rises 24.55 → 49.99% (A4-BARU). 0.14 fabricates more than its own base (F-280). The generative model path is CLOSED ([doc 111](111_TUTUP_ATAU_BELOK.md)). Do not reopen it without a pre-registration addressing F-280.

title: verl RL with verifiable rewards = DEFERRED
body: (premature + worst $/defensibility); do clustered-SFT first. (doc 44)

title: Native vision on CPU = infeasible
body: (vision encoder 10–82s/image). Keep modality-as-tool. (F-079)

title: SKIP (researched, not worth adopting):
body: ruvnet/ruvector (Rust over-promise), NVIDIA Cosmos (16–64B GPU, *generates* hallucinated frames), NeX-N2-mini 35B model (contradicts CPU-single-model), awesome-llm4ad (Autonomous *Driving*, name-collision), Qwen2.5-Omni native speech (5.5B, 18GB VRAM), big Qwen-multimodal API model (adopt routing doctrine only), LLM-judge RL reward (reward-hacking). (F-077/F-079)

title: RunPod GPU = burned $6.80 for 0 successful trains
body: (Day 49 allocation/boot failures). Use Vast.ai (5–9× cheaper, proven). (doc 44 multi-dim)

title: Substring keyword match (kw in text) over short tokens = latent bug
body: (ide⊂presiden, sintesis⊂fotosintesis, api⊂rapikan). Whole-word for single tokens. (EXP-074/F-053/F-072)

title: RRF _retrieval_score for relevance gating = unreliable
body: in small collections (rank-based, top ~0.83 even if irrelevant). Use dense cosine. (EXP-076)

title: Margin 6 for jina drops nothing
body: (its range is compressed ±4) — margin is model-specific. (EXP-081c)

title: MiniLM-L-6 (English) for ID semantic rerank = insufficient
body: (10/12, demotes relevant below junk). Use a MULTILINGUAL reranker for Indonesian. (EXP-081a)

title: Absolute drop-cutoff for episodic rerank = MOAT-UNSAFE.
body: Relevant Indonesian taught-facts score NEGATIVE on indirect queries (MiniLM −6.4, jina −1.9). Use relative-margin + always-keep-top. (EXP-081b)

title: A builder's own self-report is not validation
body: build_cycle12 said "leak=0" while an INDEPENDENT audit found inherited leak+volatile. Always validate with a separate script. (EXP-086c)

title: Greedy volatile regex (officeholder .{0,40} (saat ini|sekarang|adalah)) = false positives
body: it dropped GOOD abstain examples ("do not yet have current information about the mayor …") + unrelated reasoning. Require an asserted Capitalized NAME AND exclude abstain-markers. (EXP-086b)

title: NEVER SFT a volatile officeholder fact even when CORRECT
body: (e.g. "...is Prabowo Subianto") — goes stale next election + teaches assert-without-RAG; national_kb serves it. SFT stable behaviors only. (EXP-086b/F-088)

title: Cumulative Growth-Ring prior carries contamination forever
body: a builder that filters only the NEW increment is insufficient; a holdout near-dup + a stale-wrong "The president is Joko Widodo" sat in prior and would re-train every cycle. Apply all quality guards to the PRIOR too; re-scan prior whenever a held-out probe is added. (EXP-086b)

title: on-instance merged_16bit tar/GGUF-export is unreliable
body: (failed twice: GGUF export AND a 22MB weightless tar). For own-model trains, download the LoRA adapter (small, reliable) + merge on the VPS (CPU venv: transformers≥5 + peft matching the adapter version). That path recovered cycle-12. (F-091/092)

title: NEVER SFT an own-model on its OWN (or a weaker sibling's) generated outputs as chosen targets
body: self-distillation collapse. cycle-12 (EXP-087) trained on 22/58 organic pairs whose chosen came from local:migancore:0.3 (the weaker prod model) → 0.5 REGRESSED vs 0.4 (halu .94→.84, tool .92→.79, reason 1.0→.75), gate ROLLBACK. Use ONLY a STRONGER teacher's chosen. (F-092)

title: Don't load qwen3:30b-a3b under prod load on the 31GB box
body: OOM-kills llama-server (EXP-088); use qwen3:14b as escalation target until RAM upgrade.

title: Small models (≤4B) can't do cortex state-extraction reliably
body: qwen2.5:0.5b hallucinates an agent-trace / echoes the field descriptions / captures the surface layer; 4B already failed (F-145). JSON-schema constraint fixes FORMAT (kills the hallucinated trace) but NOT content quality. The open_question field is load-bearing (the whole anti-rot mechanism) → extractor floor is ≥7B. Don't retry sub-7B extractors; instead cache the 7B state + refresh in background so cost is amortized off the critical path. (EXP-107/F-150)
